_comment: The inn's second floor -- hallway + 3 guest-room doors (2 generic dressing, 1 Lyonette's, locked) + the PC's own room (real, walkable, holds the second sleep site). ONE open interior (no partition walls, matching the guild's own precedent of zoning via decor rather than hand-built room walls) -- 'hallway' (x1-7) and 'your room' (x8-10) read as distinct zones via floor variant + dressing, not literal walls. biome 'inn' reused (same wood-hall material as downstairs).
_comment_walls: Full 4-side perimeter, same walls-v2 idiom as inn/guild (north face+cap, sides/south cap-only) -- no interior gap needed since both stairs entities are ordinary floor-standing door props, not wall breaches.
_comment_floor: Base plank variant is the SAME reuse as guild's own floor_layers (Interior_Walls_01 plank swatch) -- the same wood-hall read continues upstairs. The (8,1,3,6) rect override gives 'your room' the herringbone swatch (inn's own 'bedroom corner' pick, same coords [16,21]/[17,21]) so it visually reads as a distinct, more private space than the hallway without any partition wall.
_comment_decor: The two generic 'more rooms than just Lyonette's' door graphics (3,1)/(5,1) are now REAL entities (see `entities` below) -- a facing interact used to hit empty space here (non-entity decor, INTERACT_NOTHING's 'Nothing there.') which read as a broken door on a visible doorway; promoted to `prop` entities carrying a generic locked_toast, same idiom as `lyonette_door` but without her name-specific copy. window_blue (10,4) dresses 'your room' -- same modest-personal-space read as the inn's own bedroom corner, not the common room's full furniture set. Issue #62 finding 1: the rug_tan that used to sit at (9,3) (one row south of `your_bed`, 9,1) is REMOVED outright -- even clear of the bed's own row, its real sprite footprint (~2 cells tall) still bled up into the bed's approach/stand cell (9,2) under y-sort, obscuring the PC there; removal (not a further re-site) per user directive.

entities._comment: Issue #62 finding 4: shifted ONE TILE UP, flush into the hallway's own NW corner (1,3 -> 1,2) as the upstairs half of the ground-floor stairs relocation (see inn's own `stairs_up` entity). Arrives here from inn's stairs_up (to_cell [1,1], one cell north of THIS door -- the same relative offset the old (1,2)/(1,3) pair had, just shifted up together). No on_enter_accomplishment (matches the guild_exit precedent: the 'entry' side banks the flavor counter, not the 'exit' side). Sprite `stairs_up`: same staircase, same door-affordance art as the ground-floor side -- it's a floor-change door, not a direction-specific graphic, matching the sprite's own registered doc comment ('THE door affordance for floor-change doors'). to_cell (1,7) mirrors the same 'land one cell north of the door, immediately re-climbable' convention the OLD (13,8) landing used relative to the OLD (14,8) stairs -- now relative to the NEW (1,8) ground-floor stairs.

Promoted from non-entity decor (a facing interact used to hit empty air here, INTERACT_NOTHING's 'Nothing there.' toast, on a doorway that plainly LOOKS like a door). A `prop` with a generic locked_toast, same idiom as `lyonette_door` below but without her name-specific copy -- there is genuinely nothing authored behind either of these two guest-room doors.

The PC's own bed -- a SECOND sleep site (interact()'s prop branch, `sleep: true`), mechanically IDENTICAL to the ground-floor `bed` (same sleep() call, same progression/toast machinery) per ratification -- NO gameplay difference v1. The ONE authored difference is `sleep_toast`, a flavor line fired BEFORE sleep()'s own stream (see wi_game.gd interact() prop branch) -- sleep-beat parity: same events (phase_changed, then either the class/level toasts or the 'You sleep soundly.' fallback), one extra toast first.

Issue #62 finding 4: the Old Chest moves up here (ground floor's own `inn_chest` cell got claimed by the relocated stairs) -- it's the PC's own storage, so 'your room' (the herringbone floor variant, x8-10) is the natural new home. Placed at (9,5), clear of the y2 hallway thoroughfare every OTHER upstairs fixture is approached from (this map's real walk lane) and off `your_bed`'s own (9,1)/(9,2) cell+approach -- approached from (9,4) facing down, the SAME north-approach/face-down convention the ground-floor chest used at its old cell. Same contents/visual_states, byte-identical otherwise.

Lyonette's room, hinted but never entered -- a `prop` (not a real `door`, it never transitions anywhere) carrying `locked_toast` (fires on a plain interact -- no `requires_skill` set, so interact()'s use_skill('', id) fallback reads it straight through the SAME seam sewers' `sewer_debris` already uses for a skill-less locked prop) and the generic ANY-entity `observe` field ([Appraise Foe]'s fallback read, the inn_sign precedent -- data-authored, not live-exercised in THIS script; see report for the fixture-cost disclosure). Placed at (7,1), the hallway's north-wall alcove between the two generic doors and the your-room zone.
entities.locked_toast: Locked. Lyonette keeps exactly one door in this inn that isn't anyone's business but hers.
entities.observe: Lyonette's door, shut the way she shuts most things: completely, and without discussion. Whatever the room looks like behind it, you'll have to imagine it; she's not one to leave doors, or herself, half open.
